lesson.grammar_point: from ... to / until for schedules + time zones (one hour behind)

listenings.text: Thank you for calling BS2 Miami. Our office is open Monday to Friday, from nine in the morning to six in the evening. On Friday, we are open until five. On Saturday and Sunday, the office is closed. For exchange, press one. For the Brazil desk, press two. Our hours are Eastern Time. That is one hour behind São Paulo, and two hours in the winter. Thank you.

Hi, it's Paul. A small piece of advice about time in the United States. People here are on time. A meeting at nine starts at nine, not at nine fifteen. Five minutes late is OK, with a message. Fifteen minutes late is a problem. And in emails, always write the time zone. Three p.m. Eastern, or three p.m. São Paulo time. It saves a lot of problems with Brazil.

extra_audio.text: I work from eight to seven. The bank is open from nine to six. Today I have a call with Miami at three. Miami is one hour behind São Paulo. So the call is at two, Miami time.
